question: ABC is an isosceles right angle triangle. Angle ABC = 90 degree and AB = 12 cm. What is the ratio of the radius of the circle inscribed in it to the radius of the circle circumscribing triangle ABC ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For an isosceles right triangle with equal sides 'a', Hypotenuse = a√2.

Inradius (r) = (Sum of legs − Hypotenuse) ÷ 2 = (a + a − a√2) ÷ 2 = a(2 − √2) ÷ 2.

Circumradius (R) = Hypotenuse ÷ 2 = a√2 ÷ 2.

Ratio r : R = [a(2 − √2) ÷ 2] : [a√2 ÷ 2] = (2 − √2) : √2.

**∴ The correct answer is 2 − √2 : √2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Triangle ABC is an isosceles right-angled triangle with ∠ABC = 90°.

AB = 12 cm, therefore BC = 12 cm (isosceles property).

**Formula Used:**

Hypotenuse (h) = √(Base² + Perpendicular²)

Inradius (r) = (Base + Perpendicular − Hypotenuse) ÷ 2

Circumradius (R) = Hypotenuse ÷ 2

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0f9b60c165b3c55c0caace2c6a70530caf2fc375a3e79741900e42128387e097.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ AC = √(12² + 12²) = √(144 + 144) = √288 = 12√2 cm

⇒ Inradius (r) = (12 + 12 − 12√2) ÷ 2

⇒ r = (24 − 12√2) ÷ 2 = 12 − 6√2 cm

⇒ Circumradius (R) = (12√2) ÷ 2 = 6√2 cm

⇒ Ratio r : R = (12 − 6√2) : 6√2

⇒ Ratio r : R = 6(2 − √2) : 6√2

⇒ Ratio r : R = (2 − √2) : √2

**∴ The correct answer is 2 − √2 : √2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Inradius of a Right Triangle

The radius of the incircle is calculated as r = (Perpendicular + Base − Hypotenuse) ÷ 2.

Circumradius of a Right Triangle

The radius of the circumcircle is half the length of the hypotenuse, R = Hypotenuse ÷ 2.

Pythagoras Theorem

In any right-angled triangle, the square of the hypotenuse is equal to the sum of the squares of the other two sides: c² = a² + b².</p
